title: VP of Product Management

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: This role owns the strategic direction and market positioning of HP's Large Format Printing portfolio (Latex, Stitch, DesignJet, Latex R series). With HP actively marketing outdoor durability, UV resistance, and 'graphics that withstand the test of time,' the VP of Product Management is responsible for ecosystem partnerships that enhance the value proposition of HP printer solutions. Tedlar represents a strategic opportunity to differentiate HP's printing systems by offering a validated, premium overlaminate solution that extends the lifespan of HP-printed graphics from 3-5 years to 12-20+ years. This role cares about: (1) Complete solution selling - moving beyond hardware to consumables and finishing materials that drive higher customer lifetime value, (2) Competitive differentiation in a commoditizing printer market, (3) Customer success metrics - reducing warranty claims and customer complaints about premature graphic failure, (4) Channel partner enablement - equipping HP's print service provider customers with materials that justify premium pricing. Given HP's recent launches (Latex 700/800 with white ink, Latex R530 hybrid) and active presence at FESPA, ISA Sign Expo, and PRINTING United, this role is actively seeking partnership opportunities that strengthen HP's market position in outdoor graphics applications.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: This VP owns portfolio strategy for HP's Large Format Printing division, including the Latex, Stitch, DesignJet, and Latex R series product lines. They hold decision authority over ecosystem partnerships, go-to-market positioning, and product roadmap direction. They likely report to a SVP/GM of Printing or Imaging & Printing Solutions, with Product Managers, Technical Product Marketing, and potentially Business Development reporting to them. Their scope spans product lifecycle management from market requirements through launch execution and performance optimization, with particular focus on outdoor graphics and signage applications where HP competes against Canon, Epson, and Roland.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: HP's customer base represents the exact target users for Tedlar protective films: sign manufacturers using HP Latex printers for outdoor signage, vehicle wrap installers printing with HP Latex 700/800 series, architectural graphics producers using HP Latex R530 for building wraps, and large-format print service providers serving transit/retail clients. The specific use cases that would matter to this VP include: (1) Outdoor signage overlaminates that extend HP Latex-printed graphics from typical 3-5 year lifespan to 12-20+ years, (2) Vehicle wrap protection films that prevent UV degradation and graffiti damage on HP-printed fleet graphics, (3) Architectural graphics overlaminates for building wraps and facades that maintain color integrity without yellowing, (4) Graffiti-resistant films for transit graphics and public-facing installations that clean easily without damaging HP-printed underlayers. These use cases directly support HP's marketing claims around 'outdoor durability' and 'graphics that withstand the test of time' by providing validated finishing solutions.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This VP likely owns KPIs including market share growth in large-format printing, customer lifetime value across hardware and consumables, competitive win rates against Canon/Epson/Roland systems, and Net Promoter Score from print service provider customers. Their personal success depends on: (1) Differentiating HP's printer portfolio in an increasingly commoditized market where equipment specs alone don't drive purchasing decisions, (2) Reducing customer churn by ensuring HP customers achieve successful outcomes that justify repeat purchases and ongoing consumables revenue, (3) Enabling premium pricing strategies by positioning HP as a complete solution provider rather than just hardware vendor, (4) Minimizing warranty claims and customer complaints about graphic performance failures that damage HP's reputation. Tedlar's value propositions directly address these stakes: extreme durability reduces customer complaints about premature failure, UV protection delivers on HP's outdoor performance promises, graffiti resistance solves a major pain point for public-facing applications, and the premium positioning supports higher total solution pricing that increases customer lifetime value.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: HP recently launched the Latex 700/800 series with enhanced white ink capability and the Latex R530 all-in-one rigid/flexible printer, creating immediate relevance for finishing solution partnerships that maximize the value of these new systems. HP is confirmed for PRINTING United Expo 2025 (October 22-24, Orlando) with a 4,000-square-foot booth, representing a major investment in market presence where validated ecosystem partnerships would strengthen their competitive positioning. The company's active presence at FESPA Global Print Expo 2025 (May 6-9, Berlin) and ISA Sign Expo 2025 signals they're in active business development mode for outdoor graphics applications. Additionally, HP's messaging around 'white ink that resists yellowing over time' and 'graphics that withstand the test of time' indicates they're addressing customer concerns about outdoor performance—making NOW the ideal time to introduce a validated overlaminate solution that substantiates these claims with third-party performance data.

personalization_hooks.hook: Recent launches of Latex 700/800 with white ink and Latex R530 hybrid printer target premium outdoor applications where graphic lifespan directly impacts customer ROI and repeat purchase decisions
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar partnership as strategic launch support for HP's new printer systems—creating differentiated bundled solutions that justify premium pricing and drive higher customer lifetime value for HP's most advanced outdoor graphics platforms

personalization_hooks.hook: HP's upcoming PRINTING United Expo 2025 booth investment and presence at FESPA/ISA Sign Expo creates immediate opportunity for co-marketing partnership and validated ecosystem messaging at industry's largest events
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Propose collaboration timeline aligned with HP's trade show calendar—developing technical validation studies and co-branded materials that position HP as the authority on durable outdoor graphics through live demonstrations at PRINTING United where HP's print service provider customers make purchasing decisions
